models_evaluated: deep learning OCT retinal segmentation system

links.outcome: PPV and number of eligible GA trial patients shortlisted, AI vs keyword EHR search
links.effect: AI shortlisted 1,139 patients (PPV 63%; 95% CI 54–71%) vs EHR search 693 (PPV 40%; 95% CI 39–42%). Combined AI-EHR: 604 patients, PPV 86%.
links.quote: The AI system shortlisted a larger number of eligible patients with greater precision (1,139, PPV: 63%; 95% CI: 54–71%) compared to the EHR search (693, PPV: 40%; 95% CI: 39– 42%).

unlisted_practices: Using AI to pre-screen patients for clinical trial recruitment
Combining AI imaging shortlist with keyword EHR search

screen.reason: The study retrospectively evaluates the diagnostic accuracy and clinical trial pre-screening performance of an AI system for retinal OCT segmentation compared to EHR search, without testing an organizational deployment safeguard or practice intervention.
